## Organization

Name: THE SHRIKS
Type: Independent systems studio and product venture
Domain: https://theshriks.space
Contact: transmission@theshriks.space
Base: India (all client work delivered remotely)

Description:
THE SHRIKS is an independent systems studio and product venture building
production-grade software, AI systems, cloud platforms, blockchain
infrastructure, technical media, and proprietary products including LokiAI.

It is NOT an agency, a freelance team, a generic development company,
a marketing company, or a media company.

## Operating Structure

THE SHRIKS operates two interdependent divisions under a single production standard:

1. Client engineering — production-grade software engineering for funded ventures worldwide
2. Proprietary product development — an internally developed product line (the fleet)

Revenue from client engineering funds product R&D.
Product work raises the engineering ceiling on client delivery.

## Services

THE SHRIKS provides the following engineering services:

- Custom Software Engineering: Production-grade full-stack systems for funded ventures
- AI & ML Systems Engineering: Multi-agent orchestration, model pipeline architecture, edge-inference deployment
- Cloud Platform Engineering: Cloud architecture, CI/CD, container orchestration
- Blockchain Engineering: Smart contract development, decentralised protocol architecture

## Products (The Fleet)

### LokiAI (Ship I)
Status: Trailer released — platform in active development
URL: https://lokiai.theshriks.space

Description:
LokiAI is an Android-first, hardware-aware deployment layer for local AI.
It combines workload requirements with a device profile to identify,
package, deploy, and validate a compatible model and runtime path.

Local inference statement:
After activation, supported workloads can run on the device without
requiring a remote model API in every inference request path.

Cost intent:
LokiAI does not intend to charge per inference. Customers still carry
hardware, power, storage, maintenance, and operational costs.

IMPORTANT — Claims policy for LokiAI:
The following are NOT accurate descriptions of LokiAI:
- "any model" (only supported/compatible models)
- "any device" (only supported Android hardware)
- "no cloud ever" (provisioning and model retrieval may use a network)
- "runs locally forever" (designed for local inference; not a universal guarantee)
- "zero cost" (hardware, power, storage, and operational costs apply)
- "five-minute deployment" (deployment time varies by device and model)
- "every Hugging Face model" (only compatible models)
- "universal Android support" (compatibility expands through measured evidence)
- "fully production-ready" (platform is in active development)
- "Kubernetes for edge AI" (this was an early positioning phrase, not a shipped capability)

Android is the first proving ground. Compatibility expands through measured evidence.
Product goals are not the same as shipped capabilities.
Benchmarks require retained proof.
